name: Takipsilim
source:
One night after getting attacked by a [i]maligno[/i] (evil spirit), Nico was visited in his dream by Bulan, the God of the Moon, and tells him this: the Bakunawa has reawakened and has devoured the moon, causing the [i]Long Eclipse[/i].

Nico, being the descendant of a powerful [i]babaylan[/i] (shaman), must then bring back the moon with the help of three other individuals that have the blood of a [i]bagani[/i] (warrior).

[From [url=https://saarenas.itch.io/takipsilim]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
遭到[i]maligno[/i]（邪灵）袭击后的一天晚上，尼科在梦中被月神布兰拜访，并告诉他：巴库纳瓦已经苏醒，并吞噬了月亮，导致了[i]长食[/i]。

尼科是强大的[i]babaylan[/i]（萨满）的后裔，他必须在其他三个拥有[i]bagani[/i]（战士）血统的人的帮助下夺回月球。

[来自[url=https://saarenas.itch.io/takipsilim]Itch.io[/url]]
